description: Panama’s national dispatch centre provides public operational information, report and statistics routes and electricity-market applications. The homepage identifies daily demand, energy delivered and renewable-energy summaries. The provider is ETESA Centro Nacional de Despacho. Coverage: Coverage is Panama’s interconnected system. Periods and resolutions vary by service; the homepage did not expose current numerical values in this reader. Access: The public homepage and service labels were read. Individual applications and downloadable reports were not exercised. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Dynamic values were blank in the retrieved page. The existence of a service route does not establish API availability, full history or an open reuse licence. For simulation it supplies official routes to demand, generation and market-operation evidence. Related resources: ASEP publishes regulatory statistics separately from the dispatch-centre services.
